items.summary: The blockchain analytics firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis link the theft of about 6.3 billion US dollars from Binance to North Korea's Lazarus group, also known as TraderTraitor. TRM Labs says most of the funds were moved out within about 20 minutes, and Chainalysis says it has high confidence in its assessment. The FBI is involved in the investigation but has not itself attributed the attack, and Binance has not commented on the attribution.

items.summary: Coinbase reported net income of 718.7 million US dollars for the third quarter of 2026, up from 432.6 million a year earlier. About 715 million dollars of that came from gains on crypto assets the company holds as investments. Total revenue fell 35 percent from a year earlier to about 1.22 billion dollars.

items.summary: Binance confirms that it lost about 6.3 billion US dollars in the security incident on 29 October 2026, and says about 3 billion of that has been frozen. According to Binance, deposits are working normally and withdrawals are expected to reopen within 48 hours. The exchange says its investigation has found additional points of breach beyond the compromised employee computer identified earlier, and that user losses will be covered from its SAFU emergency fund and its own funds.
